## [2.5.1](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/compare/v2.5.0...v2.5.1) (2026-10-31)

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **cricfy:** support CRICFy TV 7.4 ([fa73617](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/commit/fa73617cc93b555dc374a301baa812aa9bb197c8))

patches.name: Remove ads, proxy & restrictions
patches.description: Removes CashRaven background bandwidth sharing, all ads and sponsor/unlock gates, external browser redirects, the startup Telegram join dialog, promo marquee banners, forced-update lockouts, and promo push notifications. Optional clone/sniffer-check bypass and native-library stripping are off by default.

options.description: Hides the scrolling announcement/redirect marquee bar on Home and Player screens.
Skips optional and forced update prompts on Splash startup.
Suppresses promotional/browser-redirect FCM notifications and skips the startup notification permission prompt while preserving silent RemoteConfig API updates.
Allows running inside work profiles, app cloners, or alongside HTTP debugging tools.
Removes ~7.7 MB of unused CashRaven residential-proxy (libcr_android.so, libjnidispatch.so), Unity Coherence (libunitycoherencenative.so), legacy MIPS/armeabi folders, and WebView ad-viewer assets.

patches.name: Remove ads, telemetry & restrictions
patches.description: Replaces native signature-locked config decryption in pure Java so encrypted channel and event feeds keep loading after Morphe re-signs the APK, removes all banner/start/support/external ads, optionally disables the in-app web view, suppresses update lockouts, and optionally bypasses root/sniffer/proxy-cert checks. Strips Firebase telemetry and push notifications.

options.description: Disables PushService and Firebase Cloud Messaging, skips Android 13+ notification permission prompts, and removes notification permissions and receivers.
Skips forced and optional update lockouts on Splash startup and Player exit, and removes the REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission used by the in-app self-updater.

Neutralizes RootBeer/su root lockouts, Frida/sniffer package checks, and proxy-certificate lockouts. Not needed on ordinary phones/TVs; MainActivity startup tamper crash-bombs are always neutralized separately.

Removes libnative-lib.so across all ABIs (plus libtoolChecker.so when the root bypass is enabled) plus Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Sessions, DataTransport, and AdServices manifest entries. Purely a size saving; the libraries are never loaded once their Java entry points are removed.

Stubs WebActivity.onCreate to immediately finish() the activity. SK Tech TV's WebActivity is a generic in-app WebView that could be repurposed for ad landing pages via remote app.txt config; disabling it ensures no remote-config-driven WebView ad can ever render. Off by default: WebActivity also opens legitimate in-app links, and the config sanitizer already blanks the ad sponsor URLs.

patches.name: Clean Me page
patches.description: Removes the Status Saver, Legal, and Help sections from the Me page while keeping the 8-item local tools grid, App Theme, Settings, and Custom Pop-up Play.

patches.name: Custom codec
patches.description: Bundles an MX Player v3.1.0 custom codec (aio-v3.1.0_r1.zip, architecture ZIP, or libffmpeg.mx.so*) directly into the app for out-of-the-box E-AC-3, TrueHD, MLP, DTS, and AC-3 software audio decoding.

options.description: Select an MX Player Custom Codec v3.1.0 file — recommended: aio-v3.1.0_r1.zip (all CPU types), or neon64-3.1.0-build_1.zip (ARMv8 NEON), neon-3.1.0-build_1.zip (ARMv7 NEON), or a raw libffmpeg.mx.so* binary.

patches.name: Remove ads & bloat
patches.description: Removes banner, folder, player, interstitial, rewarded, app-open, exit, and Me-page ads, removes the Home horizontal shortcut strip and online Zodiac App Themes, and disables Live TV, mxplay OTT streaming, MX Tube, Shorts, and Games while keeping Local Music, All-Files-Access setup, and 1-tap Classic Themes working offline and online.

patches.name: Remove bottom navigation bar
patches.description: Removes the bottom navigation bar from the UI and moves Me to the upper-right corner of the Home toolbar. Leave unchecked to keep the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Remove ads, popups & restrictions
patches.description: Replaces the native signature-locked decryption in pure Java so encrypted channel and event feeds keep loading after Morphe re-signs the APK, and removes start/player/support/external ads plus the automatic Telegram promo dialog.

patches.name: Remove ads, telemetry & restrictions
patches.description: Replaces native signature-locked config decryption in pure Java, removes all banner/popunder/timer ads and the local NanoHTTPD ad server, suppresses the startup Telegram popup and player watermarks, strips Firebase telemetry and push notifications, and bypasses update lockouts. Optional root/sniffer bypass and native/telemetry stripping are off by default.

options.description: Hides the scrolling promo announcement card on the Events and Player screens.
Disables PushService and Firebase Cloud Messaging, skips Android 13+ notification permission prompts, and removes notification permissions and receivers.
Skips forced and optional update lockouts on Splash startup and Player exit.

Neutralizes RootBeer/su root lockouts, Frida/sniffer package checks, and proxy-certificate lockouts. Not needed on ordinary phones/TVs; MainActivity startup tamper crash-bombs are always neutralized separately.

Removes libnative-lib.so across all ABIs (plus libtoolChecker.so when the root bypass is enabled) plus Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Sessions, DataTransport, and AdServices manifest entries. Purely a size saving; the libraries are never loaded once their Java entry points are removed.

patches.name: AdBlocker turbo & userscript bundle
patches.description: Syncs SHA-256-verified pre-compiled AdBlocker binary engines + per-list filter archives (28 default lists, ~1.22M active rules) automatically in the background with instant Hosts & filters hydration, accelerates on-device filter compilation via 64 KB write buffering + foreground thread scheduling, and optionally seeds and auto-updates the mobile-adapted Bypass All Shortlinks userscript.

options.description: Cloud Pre-Built downloads SHA-256-verified pre-compiled binary filter engines and per-list archives from GitHub automatically in the background (zero on-device compilation lag and full Hosts & filters counts/sizes/dates), falling back automatically to Local Turbo if you customize filter lists. Local Turbo keeps all compilation on-device with 64 KB buffered I/O, foreground CPU scheduling, and 7-day auto-update.

Seeds and auto-updates the mobile-adapted Bypass All Shortlinks Debloated userscript (.1dmus with offline-cached MonkeyConfig, explicit @connect hosts, and zero warnings). Preserves your enabled/disabled state and never re-installs if deleted.

patches.name: Browser setup prompts only once
patches.description: Shows the default-browser, accessibility, shortcut-menu-strip, and adblocker setup prompts once, recording each as shown as soon as it appears so closing the browser before dismissing cannot make it repeat.

patches.name: Optimize cold start and battery
patches.description: Eliminates cold-start Chromium WebView initialization in Download Manager and background services, defers Browser AdBlock filter parsing until Browser launch, defers the CheckAppVersion subprocess past startup, pauses MainActivity's 1 Hz background wakeup loop when minimized, and keeps 1DM alive in Android Recents on Back press without killing background downloads.

patches.name: Preset browser settings
patches.description: Sets fresh-install browser fallbacks for normal and incognito modes: Brave search, matching suggestions, and Google search by image by default. Saved or imported choices are preserved and can be changed later in 1DM.

options.description: Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Saved or imported choices are not overwritten.
Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Match uses the selected provider when 1DM supports it, otherwise None.
Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Brave and DuckDuckGo are not supported by 1DM for reverse image search.

patches.name: Remove ads and promotions
patches.description: Removes banner, interstitial, fallback, and Amazon ads, 1DM+ sale/VPN/drawer/rate promotions, sponsored browser tiles, promo FCM topics, and 17 ad/telemetry SDK initializers and native/asset payloads from free 1DM 20.0 (30257).

release_notes:
## [2.5.1](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/compare/v2.5.0...v2.5.1) (2026-10-31)

A focused maintenance release adding support for the latest **CRICFy TV `7.4` (`54`)** release, while keeping support for **CRICFy TV `7.3` (`53`)**.

---

### 📺 CRICFy TV `7.4` support

CRICFy TV `7.4` was freshly analyzed and audited, and the **Remove ads, proxy & restrictions** patch has been updated for the new build:

- **Bandwidth sharing stays off and disabled:** CRICFy `7.4` moved the CashRaven setup into a new initialization path. The patch now blocks that new path, keeps the CashRaven foreground service disabled, and keeps its boot starter disabled, so the residential proxy cannot start. If a **Bandwidth Sharing** label/row is still shown as **OFF** in the UI, it is only a leftover display item — the feature behind it is disabled and cannot run.
- **Updated for `7.4` internals:** Rebuilt fingerprints for the `7.4` code changes so ad removal, sponsor/channel gate bypass, startup promo/Telegram popup suppression, promo push blocking, and force-update bypass continue to work on the new build.
- **Playback still works after re-signing:** The existing native `AntiTamper` handling remains in place across all supported ABIs (`arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, `x86`, `x86_64`), allowing the re-signed app to load its live configuration normally.
- **Exact-version safety kept:** The patch now accepts only audited CRICFy builds — **`7.4` (`54`)** and **`7.3` (`53`)** — and refuses unsafe mismatches instead of producing a broken APK.

### Target app

| App | Supported stock version |
| --- | --- |
| **CRICFy TV** (`com.cricfytv.sports`) | **`7.4` (`54`)** recommended; **`7.3` (`53`)** also supported |
| Stock `7.4` APK SHA-256 | `d37c0c70200981a9558d32abd16ffb7966ae83a2fc84157b82e6869c4e16ae6f` |
| Download | Official CRICFy download page: <https://cricfyapk.io/download/> |

> Always patch a **fresh stock APK**. Do not re-patch an already patched APK.

---

> **Who should re-patch?**
> - **CRICFy TV users:** Download the official stock **CRICFy TV `7.4` (`54`)** APK and patch it fresh with `patches-2.5.1.mpp`.
> - **CRICFy TV `7.3` users:** No need to re-patch unless you want to move to `7.4`; `7.3` support remains included.
> - **1DM, SK Tech TV, MX Player, CricZ TV, and PlayZ TV users:** Nothing changed for these apps in `v2.5.1`; if you are already on `v2.5.0`, there is no need to re-patch.

### ✨ Commits
